description: This is a Java test source file for the class GatewayMapperImpl, containing unit tests that verify the behavior of the getMappedGatewayDevice method, including various scenarios related to device 'via' entries and last known gateway retrieval.

classes.name: GatewayMapperImplTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the GatewayMapperImpl class, particularly testing the behavior of getMappedGatewayDevice under various scenarios.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes common test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testGetMappedGatewayDeviceUsingDeviceWithNoVia
methods.description: Tests that getMappedGatewayDevice returns the deviceId directly when there is no 'via' entry.

methods.name: testGetMappedGatewayDeviceUsingDeviceWithMappedGateway
methods.description: Tests that getMappedGatewayDevice returns the gateway from 'via' and last known gateway.

methods.name: testGetMappedGatewayDeviceReturningSingleDefinedViaGateway
methods.description: Tests that getMappedGatewayDevice uses the 'via' entry when getLastKnownGatewayForDevice returns 404.

methods.name: testGetMappedGatewayDeviceFailureUsingMultiGatewayDevice
methods.description: Verifies that a failure occurs when multiple gateways in 'via' do not match the last known gateway.

methods.name: testGetMappedGatewayDeviceFailureIfGatewayNotInVia
methods.description: Tests failure scenario when last known gateway is not in 'via' entries.

methods.name: testGetMappedGatewayDeviceFailureIfGetLastGatewayFailed
methods.description: Verifies that an exception is propagated when getLastKnownGatewayForDevice fails with server error.
